worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.summary: The user pulls a slender branch taut from the farthest reach and stabs with the spring of its tip: the longest and thinnest strike of its family. It hurts most at maximum distance — the twig bends to its limit and snaps back hardest, while point-blank only reaches the base of the branch. The thorn form sharpens the tip and snags the target with a brief slow.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.use.0: The longest, thinnest straight stab from maximum range
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.use.1: Stand at the twig's end for the full tip bonus — farther hurts more
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.use.2: Thorn form snags the target and slows it
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.description: The base of the branch deals about %1$s contact damage; reach about %2$s blocks with a %3$s block twig half-width.
Damage is multiplied by (1 + %1$s × distance/reach), so farther hurts more; a hit sheds about %2$s leaves.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.thorn.on: Thorn form: a hit snags the target for a %1$s second slow of %2$s stages, with about %3$s damage at the base; a thinner twig with less spring.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.thorn.off: Spring form: about %1$s damage at the base, a wider twig and a larger tip bonus, with a faster wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.timing: Reach %1$s blocks; %2$s seconds of wind-up, %3$s seconds of recovery, %4$s PP, then a %5$s second cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.growth.0: At level %1$s the poke rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.branchpoke.growth.1: At level %1$s the poke rises to %2$s and the reach to %3$s blocks.
On (thorn): power ×1.12 and a snaring slow on hit, at the cost of a narrower twig (radius ×0.8), tip spring ×0.6, +3 ticks of wind-up and +5 of cooldown. Off (spring): a wider twig, a larger distance bonus and a faster wind-up.
